prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE transparent PNG monster miniature sprite for Tales of Maj'Eyal's tabletop chessboard visual redesign. Create a new single forest troll token, not an atlas, not a screenshot.
Input images: image 1 is ONLY the original game's forest troll species/identity reference. Image 2 is ONLY a reference for the older prototype's steep overhead viewing angle and full-body silhouettes; IGNORE every colored ring, rocky base texture, background, and other creatures in image 2. Image 3 shows the intended board environment for scale and visual weight, not content to copy.
Subject: one squat, broad-shouldered olive-green forest troll, long heavy arms, pointed ears, broad slightly brutish face and two ivory lower-jaw tusks, coarse brown cloth loincloth, two visibly separate bare feet. Empty hands; no weapon, armor, helmet, jewelry, horns, or extra accessories.
Style/medium: a hand-painted carved miniature game piece; strong simplified shapes with tactile matte surfaces and restrained dry-brushed highlights. Enough painterly charm for a tabletop collectible, not a portrait medallion and not a flat vector icon. Identity and pose must read when the complete image is reduced to 64 pixels.
Composition: square canvas, single centered complete full body, camera steeply above looking down at about 65–70 degrees so both face and broad back/shoulders can be seen. The troll stands on one thin, PLAIN neutral dark gray-brown round disc. Disc should be nearly circular in the image (not a narrow ellipse), diameter about 86% of image width, centered horizontally and vertically with clear transparent margin all around. Thin rim only. Troll silhouette occupies about 82% of disc diameter; every hand, ear and foot stays fully inside the circular disc. Leave a clearly visible uncolored strip of base around the creature.
Lighting: soft upper-left light and short lower-right contact shadow ONLY within the disc. Troll brighter than the base, tusks/brow/fingers slightly emphasized for small-scale readability; eyes small and natural, no glowing eyes.
Palette: muted warm olive skin with pale olive highlights, dark brown cloth, warm ivory teeth and claws, neutral charcoal-brown base. No vivid saturated accent.
Background: genuine transparent alpha outside the miniature and circular base. No checkerboard pattern painted into the image, no backdrop, no floor, no outer cast shadow, no halo, no surrounding board tile.
Constraints: exactly one troll and exactly one circular base. No faction ring at all—especially no red/blue/green band. No text, labels, digits, UI, status or rank markings, grass, stones, scenery, smoke, glowing aura or border around the image. This is a faction-neutral reusable monster asset.
reference_roles: older steep overhead angle and full body silhouette only; rings and base not copied
current game board context and visual weight only
review: Correct troll identity, empty hands, all limbs within neutral round base. Genuine alpha confirmed. Generated canvas has wider margin than brief; may use mechanical alpha-bounds normalization at runtime export. Painterly dry-brush material and broad silhouette suitable as shared style reference.
image_processing: Copied original generated PNG without pixel edits, resizing, background extraction or alpha modification.
